key_phrases: Microsoft Cloud surpassed $25 billion in quarterly revenue
Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 40% and 46% in constant currency
We will invest to take share and build new businesses
The public cloud will be even a bigger winner because it does act as that deflationary force
We continue to expect double-digit revenue and operating income growth
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is cautiously optimistic. While the company reports record cloud revenue and strong long-term commitments (high confidence/moat), there is a noticeable headwind from the macro environment, specifically in the PC market (Windows OEM) and SMB segments. The forward guidance is slightly negative due to expected consumption deceleration in Azure and FX headwinds, but management remains confident in their structural advantages. The high quantitative specificity reflects a detailed breakdown of segment performance and FX impacts. Management was direct in the QA session, addressing consumption softening and macro headwinds transparently.
